rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Kasturi Rangan (India).
Introduced in India by KSG Sons/KSG's Roses in before 2013 as 'Dazzler'.
rows.Bloom: Carmine-pink, white center. Single (4-8 petals), in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
